title: Auditory-evoked spike or declared CSD response prediction

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: No model or human result is established for this task by this source review. Existing programme source and version-specific engineering evidence remain separate from scientific outcomes.
excluded_claims: Equating nominal event rates with physiological spike rates without observation/exposure verification.
Treating anatomy-only archives or seven archives as independent cohorts.
Claiming CSD or continuous LFP coverage from an uninspected NWB field or a manifest.
Inferring direct neural understanding from a frozen programme score.

summary: Separates canonical physiological region/depth prediction from the manifest’s unauthenticated nominal-event-rate scope.
Corrects source route from anatomy-only001344 to recording-bearing archive family.
Defines rate denominator, whole-animal split, anatomy/calibration leakage and response-observation requirements before any programme or direct-understanding score.
Preserves the manifest-declared animal-macro MSE primary and MAE companion while marking both unexecuted and biologically unauthenticated.
revision.source_review: Current task definition, delivered implementation source and source-provenance notes inspected; existing scientific source audits reused. No authentic recordings, protected roster or reference targets read.

evidence.supports: Preserved registered scientific target, source audits and unresolved scientific qualifications.
Only delivered runtime member; nominal-event target and26-animal counts are declarations, not authenticated task delivery.

evidence.locator: Official README, auditory-cortex layer assignment; consulted2026-11-16.
evidence.supports: Author source uses spike distributions, CSD responses and channel correlation for layer assignment, requiring explicit response-derived-anatomy handling; scripts are not a complete NWB prediction evaluator.

disposition_reason: The registration proposes held-animal region/depth spike-rate or CSD trajectories, but the only published implementation member is a manifest for nominal released-event-rate prediction. Its packet, preparation and numerical scorer are absent from this checkout. The declared26-animal/1010-query scope cannot authenticate biological spike rates or the intended shared anatomical target; retain it as a historical alternative until the bridge is supplied.

scientific_target.question: Can a frozen method predict auditory-evoked population spike-rate trajectories in held-out animals on verified shared anatomical regions/depth bins, using stimulus/timing alone or the same inputs plus permitted prior neural history?
scientific_target.known_answer: Independently measured held-out response counts divided by the actual bin exposure and eligible recorded-unit denominator, in spikes/s/source-unit on a frozen region/depth schema. A CSD trajectory is a separately declared outcome with separate units, never pooled with spike-rate error.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Recording-bearing Garcia archives001419/001420/001421 after NWB event/unit/contact/animal and clock verification. The source anatomy-only archive001344 does not supply the response target. Current nominal released-event counts are not yet authenticated as this answer.
scientific_target.case_unit: One complete held-animal stimulus trial with fixed response-bin and anatomical support masks; no per-unit correspondence between animals is presumed.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Animal, grouping all sessions and cross-archive aliases; channels/units/trials are nested measurements.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Cross-animal response prediction only after anatomy and observed exposure are verified. The present runtime manifest alone does not establish that inference; public source exposure also prevents an unseen-data claim by default.
exclusions: Equating nominal event rates with physiological spike rates without observation/exposure verification.
Treating anatomy-only archives or seven archives as independent cohorts.
Claiming CSD or continuous LFP coverage from an uninspected NWB field or a manifest.
Inferring direct neural understanding from a frozen programme score.

inputs: Stimulus identity and onset/timing information on whole trials, with anatomy established independently of scored responses.
An explicitly paired history condition may add only neural bins preceding the prediction boundary; use the same animals, trials, target support and resource budget as timing-only.
Training/validation response trajectories and eligible-unit/time-exposure denominators; all normalization fitted without query responses.
forbidden_inputs: Scored response bins, future-neural leakage through filtering, query responses used to define depth/layer alignment or select responsive units.
Hidden animal aliases, source answer-bearing filenames or independent evaluator targets.
Continuous LFP, corresponding units across animals or CSD targets unless the selected release actually verifies them.
observation_contract.case_identity: Current manifest declares26animals,16train/5validation/5query and3222/1006/1010trials,20bins, but publishes no case roster or packet/scorer. Exact source IDs, anatomical joins and query membership are unverified, not reconstructed from these counts.
observation_contract.split: Intended complete task groups every recording/alias of each animal. Manifest proposes16/5/5animal groups and one timing/history view per invocation; neither split membership nor paired-view equality is authenticated by delivered source.
observation_contract.coverage: One registered task with separate timing/history access conditions. Only manifest source is present; no executable target preparation/scoring, exact20-bin physical durations, complete response support or current candidate/reference execution is delivered.

primary.name: Animal-macro mean squared population spike-rate trajectory error (prospective physiological target; manifest-only declared metric)
primary.aggregation: Within each held animal, average squared error over predeclared eligible trial×region/depth×time bins using fixed support; then equal animals. If spike rates are authenticated, units are (spikes/s/eligible source-unit)^2.
primary.rationale: Preserves the delivered manifest’s animal_macro_mse primary and animal_macro_mae companion without implying a delivered numerical scorer. The prospective physiological response definition adds required units/exposure/anatomical authentication; CSD needs a separately frozen scale and scorer.

secondary: Animal-macro mean absolute error, preserving the manifest’s animal_macro_mae companion; physiological units require the same target authentication.
Per-animal and per-region/depth error and support/coverage; retain absent anatomical bins explicitly.
Paired timing-only versus history-augmented error on the identical query universe.
Separately reported CSD error only after verified units, corresponding depth and complete exposure.

comparators.name: Training population mean trajectory
comparators.inputs: Training animals only, same stimulus and frozen shared anatomical schema.
comparators.procedure: Proposed fixed stimulus-conditioned mean response; support masks and fallback for unseen stimulus/region fixed before query.

comparators.name: Timing-only versus history regression
comparators.inputs: Identical stimulus/timing metadata, with prior neural history added only in the declared second arm.
comparators.procedure: Proposed fixed ridge baseline: training-only feature scaling, alpha grid [0.01,0.1,1,10,100] selected by animal-grouped validation MSE, with nonnegative output clipping fixed before query. Timing-only and history-augmented variants use identical targets and splits; this comparator must be implemented and qualified before evaluation.

nuisance_controls: Verify complete observation windows: no released event is not evidence of observed silence.
Establish actual spikes/unit, channel contact, stimulus onset and time exposure before assigning rate units.
Define anatomical correspondence and unit eligibility without selecting on evaluation responses; disclose response-derived laminar assignment and use separate calibration trials.
Keep trial boundaries and full filter/lag support outside scored future bins; compare recording density and missing-depth patterns across animals.
evaluation.uncertainty: Bootstrap or summarize paired errors by biological animal after cross-archive identity reconciliation; five declared query animals would limit inference even if authenticated. Do not treat1010trials or20bins as independent animal replication.
evaluation.failure_policy: Do not score until authentic case IDs, units, time exposure and target masks are bound. Require one finite trajectory per exact case/support bin; reject duplicates, omissions, extra cases and undefined normalization. Missing anatomy is declared support, not silently dropped favorable cases.

implementation.scorer_target: No numerical scorer body is delivered. The manifest declares animal_macro_mse primary and animal_macro_mae secondary with equal weight for five query animals and every query trial/bin required. Its nominal released-event-rate title does not verify physiological rate units or the canonical region/depth trajectory target.
implementation.delivered_scope: Unqualified programme registration proposal only, one view per invocation, historical authoring-path references and explicit no execution/qualification flags.
missing: Actual preparation/scoring source and authenticated public/private packet schema for the declared26animal scope.
Verified response semantics, complete observed intervals, per-unit denominator and physical bin widths.
Cross-animal anatomical correspondence and exact IDs/splits; paired timing/history evaluation.
implementation.execution_evidence: Manifest explicitly records no actual candidate, grader, image or runtime qualification and no scientific execution during source construction; this revision only inspects its public bytes.
